sections.explanation: NumPy arrays store numerical sequences and apply arithmetic element by element. import introduces a library; as gives it a short name. Matplotlib plots corresponding x/y values; labels and units are part of the result. np.loadtxt reads a simple numeric CSV: delimiter names the separator and skiprows=1 skips its header. A[:, 0] selects all rows of the first column; indexing begins at zero. Use the supplied CSV beside your notebook. If libraries are missing, install numpy and matplotlib in the selected notebook environment, then restart the kernel.

sections.code:
import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
data = np.loadtxt("position.csv", delimiter=",", skiprows=1)
time_s = data[:, 0]
position_m = data[:, 1]
plt.plot(time_s, position_m, "o-")
plt.xlabel("Time / s")
plt.ylabel("Position / m")
plt.show()
